paite: TOUPA ka ngakngak a; ama'n ahon ngeingaih a, ka kikou azata hi.
heading: David La / Phatna La
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

paite: Manthatna kokhuk a kipan, buannawi diadua a pan ahon khaikhetou a; huchi in ka khe suangpi tung ah angala, ka kalsuante ahihkip hi.
english: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

paite: La thak ka kam ah akoih a, i Pathian phatna; mi tampi'n huai amu ding ua, alau ding ua, TOUPA amuang ding uhi.
english: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.

paite: TOUPA a muanna nei a, kisatheite leh thuzuau a kipan a kihemkhemi ahampha hi.
english: Blessed is the man who makes Yahweh his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

paite: TOUPA ka Pathian aw, nang thillamdang na hihte leh koumau lam na hon ngaihtuahnate atam mahmah a, huaite na ma a hihlat zoh vual ahi kei ding.
english: Many, Yahweh, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

paite: Kithoihna leh thillat tung ah kipahna na nei kei a; ka bilte na hon honsakta a; halmang a thillat leh khelhna ding a thillat na phut kei hi.
english: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

paite: Huaitak in, ke'n, "Ngai in, ka hong pai hi; laibuzial ah ka thu gelh ahi.
english: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

paite: Ka Pathian aw, na deihlam hih ka kipah lamtak ahi; ahi, na dan thu ka lungtang ah a-om gige hi," ka chi a.
english: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

paite: Kikhopna thupitak ah diktatna thuhoih ka tangkoupih a; TOUPA aw, ngai in, ka kam ka it kei ding chih na thei hi.
english: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Yahweh, you know.

paite: Na diktatna ka lungsung ah ka iim kei a; na ginomna leh na hotdamna thu ka tangkoupih zaw ding; na zahngaihna leh na takna kikhopna thupitak a mite lak ah ka sel kei ding hi.
english: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

paite: TOUPA aw, na lainatnate ka lak ah it ke'nla; na zahngaihna leh na takna in hon humbit gige in.
english: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, Yahweh. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

paite: Thil hoih lou sim zoh louh in hon umsuak a, ka thulimlouhnate'n hon delhpha a, huchi in ka dak theita kei a; huaite ka samzang sang in atamzaw a, ka lungtang atawlta hi.
heading: Panpih Ding A Thumna / (Sam 70)
english: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

paite: TOUPA aw, hehpih in hon humbit inla; TOUPA aw, hon panpih ding in kin in.
english: Be pleased, Yahweh, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Yahweh.

paite: Ka hinna hihmang tum a zongte zahlak leh zumtak in om chiat uhen; ka siatna tung a kipakte kik nawn in hihzum in om uhen.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

paite: Awi hang e! Awi hang! chite azahlak ziak un mangbangtak in om uhen.
english: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

paite: Nang hon zong tengteng nangmah ah nuamtak leh kipaktak in om uhenla; na hotdamna itte'n, TOUPA phat in om hen, chi gige uhen.
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let Yahweh be exalted!”

paite: Kei zaw genthei leh liangvai ka hi a, himahleh Toupa'n ahon ngaihtuah a; nang hon panpihpa leh hon humbitpa na hi a; ka Pathian aw, sawt hal mahmah ke'n.
english: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
